svg.title: Quarry worker — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as quarry worker, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A broad stone block is split by a narrow downward wedge and one clean zigzag fracture. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
